verdict.rationale:
Docs describe Feature Gates supporting Scheduled Rollouts to 'gradually deploy a feature over time' and 'schedule gradual feature rollouts to safely deploy new code' without redeploying, and evaluation is explicitly deterministic so the same user always gets the same bucket assignment as rollout percentage changes. Exposure monitoring in the console lets developers track rollout progress live.

missing for 10: explicit documentation of a percentage-based slider/increment mechanism (e.g., 1%→100%) and independent/hands-on confirmation of consistent bucketing during a live ramp.
